messages:
nina: Quick idea 1
Can we prototype a "token garden" compact tile for Console home that shows per-model marginal cost, recent cache-savings, and routing impact per-route?
kevin: +1. Lightweight tiles would be great for PMs and SREs. :seedling:
samir: Clarify "marginal cost" is that after cache & batching amortization per-invocation?
nina: Exactly effective per-invocation cost (not invoice), so engineers see immediate economics.
emma: Prefer a small timeseries sparkline + last-invocation sample. Don't do heavy joins in UI queries.
ashley: Routing impact needs to show fallback deltas  which fallback triggered and count. Otherwise it's not actionable.
nina: UX idea: tile fields: model, avg cost/token, tokens_saved_by_cache, fallback_rate. Click expands to 5 sample traces.
kevin: Backend needs a compact pre-agg keyed by (route, model, minute) with tokens_total, tokens_cached, invocations, fallback_count. Easy to roll up for UI.
samir: Draft MV SQL: SELECT route_id, model_sku, date_trunc('minute', ts) minute, SUM(tokens) tokens_total, SUM(tokens_cached) tokens_from_cache, COUNT(1) invocations, SUM(is_fallback::int) fallback_count FROM token_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1,2,3;
emma: Watch tokens_cached semantics. Edge sometimes double-counts when prefix and KV caches both claim hits. Need winner-only or dedupe.
kevin: Add cache_winner boolean to event schema so MV uses only winner=true. Infra can own MV and API.
ashley: Frontend wants per-route quota burn projection on tile (24h current rate + 95pci conservative). Can we calculate that in service and return numbers?
nina: Yes backend exposes projected_burn_24h and burn_confidence. Show confidence visually.
samir: Sampling constraints: full res for top 100 tenants, 1% sampling for others, extrapolate. Must show confidence indicator.
emma: Agreed. UX: color code tile by confidence and highlight canary vs baseline when a rollout is active.
kevin: For canaries tile should show canary vs baseline side-by-side and a "cost-aware rollback" quick link if delta > 2x.
devex-bot: NOTE: cost-aware rollback suggestion requires feature-flag 'econ-ops-suggestions'. Calling /internal/rollback-suggest will run checks. :robot_face:
ashley: SLA on freshness? Console team wants <=2m staleness and an API filter by route+model.
kevin: Infra takes ownership. Will add SLA and pagination to API. Compute budget TBD.
nina: Action items: kevin prototype MV+API, samir add cache_winner and plan backfill, emma/UX mock tiles (confidence + canary diff), ashley define rollback button UX and guardrails. I'll write a short spec tomorrow.
emma: I'll make a 320px tile mock with confidence ribbon and hover traces.
samir: I'll prepare the migration PR for cache_winner and a patch to token_events ingestion to set winner deterministically.
kevin: I'll stub endpoint /internal/econ/preagg?route=&model=&since= and return top-N models per route with projection.
nina: Great. If anyone sees a missing piece speak up here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
